name: Category Chain
description_short: A shrinking-time-limit naming game — students go round the group adding items to a category without repeating, until someone hesitates or repeats.
teacher_note: The genuine 5-minute filler I reach for when a lesson ends early and I don't want to just let class out. Needs literally nothing prepared.
creator: Free Range Tutors
duration_alt_note: Runs longer if you play 3-4 rounds with different categories back to back.
